statement: Pinned Linux hid-wiimote helper waits up to one kernel HZ-second for command completion, in interruptible and noninterruptible variants; register writes and reads call that helper and treat command errors or unsuccessful read completion as failures. This is a consumer-side timeout budget, not an observed Wii Remote ACK latency or report frequency.

applicability.revision: Emulator or Linux/SDL host source behavior; retail revision not measured
applicability.scope: hid-wiimote.h 345-374; hid-wiimote-core.c 362-405; hardware timings remain unknown.
